data.caption: A serene and meditative piece featuring a gentle, arpeggiated acoustic guitar melody over a subtle, atmospheric synth pad. A clear, reverent female vocal enters, singing a Sanskrit mantra with a spacious reverb that enhances the spiritual quality of the performance. The arrangement is minimal and calming, functioning as a brief introduction with sung choral non-English instructions before the track concludes.
data.lyrics:
